Description: Send OTP to phone. Creates new user if not found. Normalizes and hashes phone.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Phone number is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid phone number" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Phone missing → 400: 'Phone number is required' | 2) Invalid phone format → 400: 'Invalid phone number' | 3) OTP service failure → passes to global error handler | 4) Play Store test phone (+61800000000) → simulated success without sending OTP

Description: Verify phone OTP. Returns accessToken + refreshToken + full user profile. Creates user if new. Checks ban/suspension. Assigns milestone eligibility.
Success Response Body: { "success": true, "message": "Welcome! Phone verified successfully | Welcome back! Login successful", "data": { "accessToken": "jwt...", "refreshToken": "raw...", "user": { account, profile, attributes, discovery, discoveryFilters, location, photos, verification, settings, isPhoneVerified, isEmailVerified, onboarding } } }
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Phone and OTP is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "OTP expired or invalid" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid OTP" } | { "success": false, "message": "Your account has been banned..." } | { "success": false, "message": "Your account is suspended until <date>" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Phone/OTP missing → 400: 'Phone and OTP is required' | 2) Invalid phone format → 400: 'Invalid phone number' | 3) OTP expired (Redis TTL) → 400: 'OTP expired or invalid' | 4) Wrong OTP → 400: 'Invalid OTP' | 5) Account banned → 400: 'Your account has been banned' | 6) Account suspended → 400: 'Your account is suspended until <date>' | 7) Play Store bypass: +61800000000 + 123456 always passes

Description: DEV/QA: Send OTP and return OTP in response. Returns full user profile if user exists. OTP stored in plain Redis.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Phone is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid phone number" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Phone missing → 400: 'Phone is required' | 2) Invalid phone → 400: 'Invalid phone number' | 3) Internal error → 400: error.message | 4) Play Store phone (+61800000000) → OTP fixed as '123456'

Description: DEV/QA: Verify test OTP (plain text Redis match). Returns tokens + full user profile. Tracks sessions and login history.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Phone and OTP are required" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid OTP" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Phone/OTP missing → 400: 'Phone and OTP are required' | 2) Invalid phone → 400: 'Invalid phone number' | 3) Wrong OTP → 400: 'Invalid OTP' | 4) Play Store bypass: +61800000000 + 123456 | 5) Session tracking: deviceId + IP + login history (max 15 entries; 5 devices)

Description: Send email verification OTP. Phone must be verified first. Checks email uniqueness. OTP stored in user doc with 10-min expiry.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Authentication token is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "User not found" } | { "success": false, "message": "Phone must be verified before email verification" } | { "success": false, "message": "Email already in use" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) No auth token → 401: 'Authentication token is required' | 2) Invalid/expired token → 400: error.message | 3) User not found → 400: 'User not found' | 4) Phone not verified → 400: 'Phone must be verified before email verification' | 5) Email used by another account → 400: 'Email already in use' | 6) Play Store test email (test@keenasmustard.com) → skips actual email

Description: Verify email OTP. Marks email as verified. Updates onboarding progress. Returns updated user profile (no new tokens).
Success Response Body: { "success": true, "message": "Email verified successfully", "data": { "user": { <full profile with isEmailVerified: true> } } }
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Authentication token is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "OTP not found" } | { "success": false, "message": "OTP expired" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid OTP" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) No auth token → 401: 'Authentication token is required' | 2) Invalid/expired token → 400: error.message | 3) User not found → 400: 'User not found' | 4) OTP not in user doc → 400: 'OTP not found' | 5) OTP expired (>10 min) → 400: 'OTP expired' | 6) Wrong OTP → 400: 'Invalid OTP' | 7) Play Store: test@keenasmustard.com + 123456 always passes

Description: Exchange valid refresh token for new access token. Cleans expired tokens from DB. Returns updated user profile.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Refresh token missing in header" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid refresh token" } | { "success": false, "message": "Refresh token expired" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) No Authorization header → 401: 'Refresh token missing in header' | 2) Header not starting with 'Bearer ' → 401: 'Refresh token missing in header' | 3) Token hash not found in any user → 401: 'Invalid refresh token' | 4) Token found but expired → 401: 'Refresh token expired' | 5) Max 5 refresh tokens per user (FIFO)

Description: Invalidate refresh token and remove FCM token for specific device. Idempotent — returns success even if token already invalid.
All Error Scenarios: 1) Invalid/missing refresh token → still returns success (idempotent) | 2) Internal error → 400: error.message | 3) Also removes FCM token for given deviceId to stop push notifications

Description: Resend OTP to phone. Currently routes to sendTestOtp controller (returns OTP in response).
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Phone is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid phone number" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Phone missing → 400: 'Phone is required' | 2) Invalid phone → 400: 'Invalid phone number' | 3) Note: Currently maps to sendTestOtp (returns OTP in response — dev only) | 4) Play Store phone bypass applies

Description: Resend email verification OTP. Rate limited: 3 per minute per IP. Reuses sendEmailOtp service.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Authentication token is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "Email is required" } | { "success": false, "message": "Too many attempts. Please try again after a minute." }
All Error Scenarios: 1) No auth token → 401: 'Authentication token is required' | 2) Email missing → 400: 'Email is required' | 3) Rate limit exceeded → 429: 'Too many attempts. Please try again after a minute.' | 4) Invalid token → 400: error.message | 5) Play Store email (test@keenasmustard.com) → simulated success

Description: Unified social login for Google/Facebook/Apple. Verifies provider token and creates or finds user.
Success Response Body: { "success": true, "message": "google login successful", "data": { "userId": "mongo_id", "accessToken": "jwt...", "refreshToken": "raw...", "isNewUser": true, "isPhoneVerified": false, "isEmailVerified": true, "nextStep": "VERIFY_PHONE", "authMethod": "google" } }
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Provider is required", "code": "MISSING_PROVIDER" } | { "success": false, "message": "Invalid provider...", "code": "INVALID_PROVIDER" } | { "success": false, "message": "ID token is required", "code": "MISSING_ID_TOKEN" } | { "success": false, "message": "Access token is required for Facebook", "code": "MISSING_ACCESS_TOKEN" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Provider missing → 400: MISSING_PROVIDER | 2) Invalid provider → 400: INVALID_PROVIDER | 3) Facebook without accessToken → 400: MISSING_ACCESS_TOKEN | 4) Google/Apple without idToken → 400: MISSING_ID_TOKEN | 5) Invalid/expired token → 400: INVALID_TOKEN / TOKEN_EXPIRED | 6) Server error → 500: UNKNOWN_ERROR

Description: Link a social account (Google/Facebook/Apple) to existing authenticated user.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Provider is required", "code": "MISSING_PROVIDER" } | { "success": false, "message": "This account is already linked", "code": "ALREADY_LINKED" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Provider missing → 400: MISSING_PROVIDER | 2) Token missing → 400: MISSING_ID_TOKEN / MISSING_ACCESS_TOKEN | 3) Already linked → 409: ALREADY_LINKED | 4) Invalid token → 400: INVALID_TOKEN

Description: Unlink a social account from authenticated user.
Error Response Body: { "success": false, "message": "Provider is required", "code": "MISSING_PROVIDER" } | { "success": false, "message": "Google is not linked", "code": "NOT_LINKED" }
All Error Scenarios: 1) Provider missing → 400: MISSING_PROVIDER | 2) Provider not linked → 404: NOT_LINKED | 3) Other errors → 400: dynamically mapped code

Description: Get all linked social accounts for authenticated user.
All Error Scenarios: 1) Auth middleware fail → 401 (handled by middleware) | 2) Internal error → 500: INTERNAL_ERROR
